verification_report.summary:
The entire staged section is correct under the supplied internal premises. Verification followed the textual order and found no critical errors or gaps.

The concave-envelope lemma genuinely starts with u in E_phi: bounded slope supplies the same-class stretching competitor, and upward stability gives p in E_phi. The exact local truncations max(p,q-j) and max(phi,q-j) remain theta-psh. Coordinate monotonicity of the inverse-weight transformation produces genuine decreasing local limits that agree globally. Strict-comparison locality transfers the bounded product inequality, and non-pluripolarity removes the discarded poles. Ordered contact then gives the claimed envelope measure bound. No semipositivity or closedness of theta, open locally bounded model locus, or prior ordinary type is assumed.

In the moment proposition, H(S)>0 justifies the weight construction for every finite 1<S<T, even when T is initially infinite. Tonelli gives the stated uniform K. The identity (n+1/2)/(2n+1)=1/2 validates the energy estimate, and the model normalization identity together with mass at least ell gives -sup p<=K A_1/ell^2. Applying the datum moment to p-sup p yields the stated uniform C_0. Every scalar differentiation is justified by absolute continuity. The resulting exponents gamma=3/[2(2n+2)]<1 and kappa=(m+1)/(2n+2)>1 force a finite uniform bound on T. Zero domination has the correct hypotheses and order; T<=1 and B=0 are covered. Constants depend only on the listed parameters, independently of S, u, and the weight slope bound.

Skoda moments and Holder give the required datum moments for both Lp equations. The finite factor exp(lambda sup u) suffices for each positive-exponent solution; no uniform bound in that supremum is asserted. Both conclusions establish bounded difference from phi. Only their existence assertions remain conditional on the specified general-measure theorems. Neither preliminary result depends on those existence theorems. No domination of relative max-truncations by the original datum is assumed.

The attribution matches XL26 Corollary 6.1. Its Theorem 5.1 assumes ordinary type beforehand, but the submitted proof independently establishes the needed estimate and imports no relative boundedness conclusion. The source's upper-volume class definition and rooted moment convention were distinguished from raw mass and this proof's unrooted A_m. [XL26](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.13446v1).
